> **Extension Name:**
> SushiScan
> 
> **Version:**
> 1.0.0
> 
> **GitHub Repository / Download Link:**
> [Click Here](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/branrgx/seanime-extensions/main/src/SushiScan/manifest.json) / Copy the link below: 
> ```https://raw.githubusercontent.com/branrgx/seanime-extensions/main/src/SushiScan/manifest.json```
> 
> **Description:**
> An extension for Seanime for SushiScan, a French platform offering an extensive library of mangas, manhuas, manhwas, comics and BDs in French.
> 
> **Additional Notes:**
> This extension supports bypassing Cloudflare challenges via FlareSolverr. To use it, you must have FlareSolverr installed and running on your machine. Enable the proxy option in the extension settings and set your FlareSolverr URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8191). If SushiScan stops using Cloudflare challenges, you can disable the bypass from the same settings.
